name_zh: 尼日利亚·恩纳姆迪·阿齐基韦：泛非首任总统与伊博报纸民族建构
name_en: Nigeria Nnamdi Azikiwe: Pan-African First President & Igbo Newspaper Nation-Building
description_zh: 恩纳姆迪·阿齐基韦 (1904-1996) 尼日利亚首任总统 (1963-1966)，创办《西非朝报》唤醒民族意识，泛非主义推动加纳独立与非洲统一组织成立，伊博精英跨族群民族建构。
description_en: Nnamdi Azikiwe (1904-1996) Nigeria first President (1963-1966), founded West African Pilot awakening national consciousness, Pan-Africanism drove Ghana independence and OAU founding, Igbo elite cross-ethnic nation-building.
reason_zh: 阿齐基韦代表西非泛非主义如何通过报纸媒体与跨族群精英联盟构建民族国家，展示了伊博商业精神如何转化为政治领导力，其首任总统地位象征尼日利亚从殖民地到主权国家的完成。
reason_en: Azikiwe represents how West African Pan-Africanism built nation-state through newspaper media and cross-ethnic elite alliance, demonstrating how Igbo commercial spirit transformed into political leadership, his first presidency symbolizing Nigeria transition from colony to sovereign state completion.
steps_zh: 研究阿齐基韦早年美国林肯大学教育与报纸创办
分析《西非朝报》民族主义唤醒与泛非网络构建
探讨1960年独立与1963年共和国首任总统就职
评估1966年政变下台与比夫拉战争调解努力
总结泛非首任总统伊博报纸民族建构对尼日利亚国家认同的奠基
steps_en: Study Azikiwe early US Lincoln University education and newspaper founding
Analyze West African Pilot nationalist awakening and Pan-African network construction
Explore 1960 independence and 1963 Republic first President inauguration
Evaluate 1966 coup ousting and Biafra war mediation efforts
Summarize Pan-African first President Igbo newspaper nation-building foundational role for Nigerian national identity
expected_zh: 理解报纸媒体如何成为民族想象共同体构建核心工具，掌握泛非主义与区域精英联盟双重民族建构路径，评估阿齐基韦对西非去殖民化进程的决定性领导。
expected_en: Understand how newspaper media becomes national imagined community construction core tool, grasp Pan-Africanism and regional elite alliance dual nation-building path, evaluate Azikiwe decisive leadership for West African decolonization process.
case_zh: 1937 创办朝报；1960 独立；1963 首任总统；1996 逝世。泛非首任总统伊博报纸民族范式永存。
case_en: 1937 founded Pilot; 1960 independence; 1963 first President; 1996 death. Pan-African first President Igbo newspaper nation paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Pan-Africanism; newspaper nationalism; first President; Igbo leadership
